name: Edge spike jump: the last jump inside a spike strip's grace
techNote: A floor (top y 0) runs right into a 19-tall spike strip (layer 6, spikeScript; x 0-200, the height of the game's floor spike bands), the floor going on under it to x 400 over a pit, and a landing platform from x 582. The dot runs in at full speed (460). spikeScript has no OnTriggerEnter2D and kills on the Stay that counts past graceFrames 1, so the hurtbox (x-15..x+25, y-27..y+27 facing right) may sit in the strip on 2 ticks: it enters on tick 19 (x -16, spike2 *0), counts 1 on tick 20 (*1), and the jump on tick 21 (the ground rays stand on the floor under the trigger) lifts it clear before the 2nd Stay. That takeoff is 18.4 u (2 ticks) past the last jump that never touches the strip (tick 19, from x -25.2): a tick-19 jump lands on a platform whose edge is at x 568 at most, a tick-21 one up to x 586, and the platform's edge sits between. Of press ticks 0-29 only 21 finishes. Ghosts: before (tick 19: falls short into the pit), late (tick 22: a 3rd tick in the strip, dies). The margin is phase-bound: another run-in phase moves the grace jump's takeoff by up to a tick.

ghosts.label: Edge spike jump: jump on the 3rd tick, 2 in the spikes
Last jump before the spikes: falls short
One tick later: 3rd tick in the spikes, dies
